hello.title: Let's work on {{subject}}
hello.body: Tell me what you already know and I will help you get there. I use your grade's lessons only, and I help you work it out instead of handing you the answer.

steps.one: You explain it back in your own words first.
steps.two: I give one hint at a time, never the answer.
steps.three: After two tries, we work through the full answer together.

settings.hint: This switch covers the whole school. You can still pause or lock a single class in the Class access tab.

rules.repeat: Repeat the unit and chapter numbers on every lesson row.
rules.quote: Put quotes around any cell that contains a comma.
rules.limits: Up to 400 lessons per file and 20,000 characters per lesson.
rules.standards: Put standards in the standards column, separated by |.

import.readFailed: This CSV could not be read.
import.importFailed: The lessons could not be imported.
import.helpBody: Columns: unit_number, unit_title, chapter_number, chapter_title, lesson_number, lesson_title, content, standards, keywords. Leave unit and chapter empty for a flat lesson list; when a number is filled, its title is required. The full guide is in csvFiles/tutor-lessons-README.md.
